description: Source code for the QuicFlowController class, implementing flow control logic in QUIC protocol, including window management, flow control violation detection, and window updates.

classes.name: QuicFlowController
classes.description: Implements flow control logic for QUIC streams, managing window sizes, flow control violations, and window updates.

methods.name: LogLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for logging, indicating whether the controller is for a connection or a stream.

methods.name: AddBytesConsumed
methods.description: Increases the count of bytes consumed and potentially triggers a window update.

methods.name: UpdateHighestReceivedOffset
methods.description: Updates the highest received byte offset if the new offset is greater.

methods.name: AddBytesSent
methods.description: Increases the count of bytes sent and checks for flow control violations.

methods.name: FlowControlViolation
methods.description: Checks if flow control has been violated based on received byte offsets.

methods.name: MaybeIncreaseMaxWindowSize
methods.description: Auto-tunes the receive window size based on RTT and timing of window updates.

methods.name: IncreaseWindowSize
methods.description: Doubles the receive window size up to a limit.

methods.name: WindowUpdateThreshold
methods.description: Returns the threshold at which to send a window update.

methods.name: MaybeSendWindowUpdate
methods.description: Decides whether to send a window update based on current window usage.

methods.name: UpdateReceiveWindowOffsetAndSendWindowUpdate
methods.description: Updates the receive window offset and sends a window update.

methods.name: MaybeSendBlocked
methods.description: Sends a BLOCKED frame if flow control is blocking data transmission.

methods.name: UpdateSendWindowOffset
methods.description: Updates the send window offset if increased, returning whether it unblocked the flow.

methods.name: EnsureWindowAtLeast
methods.description: Ensures the receive window is at least a specified size, increasing if necessary.

methods.name: IsBlocked
methods.description: Returns true if the send window size is zero, indicating flow control blocking.

methods.name: SendWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of the send window.

methods.name: UpdateReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Updates the receive window size and offset.

methods.name: SendWindowUpdate
methods.description: Sends a window update frame for the current receive window offset.
